gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.title: Hospital Account Management
gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.description: Automated system for centralized user account creation at Hospital Penco Lirquen, using Playwright to automate workflows and reduce operational times.
gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.stackDescription: Pure PHP backend with MySQL for data management, Playwright (JavaScript) browser automation to create accounts across hospital systems, and Bootstrap frontend for a clean, responsive admin interface.
gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.problem: The hospital needed to create and manage over 12 different types of user accounts for its staff, a slow manual process prone to errors.
gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.solution: I built a PHP solution with Playwright that automates account creation and management, centralizing the entire workflow in a unified Bootstrap interface.
gestion-cuentas-hospitalarias.results: 100% of the account creation process was automated, eliminating manual errors and drastically reducing IT department operational times.

motor-validacion-ia.title: AI Validation Engine
motor-validacion-ia.description: Award-winning platform from a programming competition that analyzes construction progress in industrial installation projects, using Gemini Flash to verify and contrast weekly reports.
motor-validacion-ia.stackDescription: Laravel (PHP) backend integrating Gemini Flash API for report analysis, React frontend for data visualization, PostgreSQL as the relational database, and Python for preprocessing reports before AI analysis.
motor-validacion-ia.problem: Industrial installation companies had to manually verify construction progress by contrasting weekly reports, a slow process with high probability of human error.
motor-validacion-ia.solution: I built a Laravel and React platform that integrates Gemini Flash to automatically analyze reports, contrast them with the previous week, and measure real construction progress.
motor-validacion-ia.results: The system achieved 90% accuracy in progress analysis, earning first place in the programming competition.
